bg-10-01.why: 만나- has stem vowel ㅏ, taking -았어요 to become 만났어요.

bg-10-01.q: Say what you did yesterday using 어제 and 갔어요.

bg-10-01.why: Vowels merge without batchim: 만나 + 았어요 → 만났어요.

steps.en: I met a friend yesterday, myself.

en: We went to a restaurant together.
And we drank coffee at the cafe.

bg-10-01.why: The text states '우리는 같이 식당에 갔어요' (We went to a restaurant together).

bg-10-01.q: What did they drink at the cafe?
bg-10-01.why: The passage says '카페에서 커피를 마셨어요' (We drank coffee at the cafe).

items: Form the polite past tense by adding -았어요 or -었어요
Describe activities completed yesterday in Korean

bg-10-02.hint: I went to Jeju Island last week.
bg-10-02.why: 지난주에 sets the past time frame, pairing with 갔어요.

bg-10-02.q: State that you drank coffee earlier using 아까 and 마셨어요.
bg-10-02.why: 마시다 contracts with -었어요 to form 마셨어요.

steps.en: I watched a movie at home yesterday.

en: I went to Jeju Island last week.
I also took lots of photos.

bg-10-02.q: Where did the speaker go last week?
bg-10-02.why: The passage begins with '지난주에 제주도에 갔어요' (I went to Jeju Island last week).
The text says '바다가 정말 아름다웠어요' (The sea was truly beautiful).

items: Use time words like 어제, 아까, and 지난주 with past tense verbs
Share past travel experiences and dining memories

bg-10-03.hint: I wrote a letter to a friend yesterday.
bg-10-03.why: 쓰다 drops ㅡ and merges with -었어요 to become 썼어요.

bg-10-03.q: State that you wrote a diary entry in Korean using 한국어로 and 썼어요.
bg-10-03.why: 쓰다 becomes 썼어요 in the past tense: 한국어로 일기를 썼어요.

bg-10-03.hint: The vowel ㅡ drops before vowels: 쓰 + 었어요 contracts to 썼어요.
bg-10-03.why: 쓰다 drops ㅡ, forming 썼어요 rather than 쓰었어요.

steps.en: Yesterday I wrote a diary entry.
Yesterday I wrote a diary entry in Korean.

en: Because it was the weekend yesterday, I cleaned the house cleanly.
And I sat on the desk chair.
I wrote a letter to send to my friend.
In the evening, I read a book at the library.

bg-10-03.q: What did the speaker clean yesterday?
bg-10-03.why: The text states '집을 깨끗하게 청소했어요' (I cleaned the house cleanly).

bg-10-03.q: What did the speaker do after sitting at the desk?
bg-10-03.why: The passage says '친구에게 보낼 편지를 썼어요' (I wrote a letter to send to my friend).

items: Properly contract vowel stems in the past tense (쓰다 → 썼어요)
Conjugate consonant stems with past vowel harmony (앉다 → 앉았어요)

bg-10-04.hint: I walked in the park for 30 minutes yesterday.
bg-10-04.why: 걷다 changes ㄷ to ㄹ before vowels: 걸었어요.

bg-10-04.q: State that you listened to music yesterday using 어제 and 들었어요.
bg-10-04.why: 듣다 turns ㄷ into ㄹ before past ending -었어요: 들었어요.

bg-10-04.hint: 듣다 softens ㄷ into ㄹ before vowels: 들었어요.
bg-10-04.why: 듣다 is a ㄷ-irregular verb: 듣 + 었어요 becomes 들었어요.

steps.en: Yesterday I walked in the park.
Yesterday I walked in the park with a friend.

ko: 하지만 따뜻한 옷을 입고 공원을 걸었어요.
en: Yesterday the weather was a little cold.
However, I wore warm clothes and walked in the park.
I listened to good music with earphones.
I helped neighbors in need and it was rewarding.

bg-10-04.why: The text states '어제는 날씨가 조금 추웠어요' (Yesterday the weather was a little cold).

bg-10-04.q: What did the speaker listen to while walking?
bg-10-04.why: The passage says '이어폰으로 좋은 음악을 들었어요' (I listened to good music with earphones).

items: Apply irregular stem transformations to past tense verbs (듣다 → 들었어요)
Comfortably tell stories combining regular and irregular past verbs
